summary: Schemathesis 4.32.4 fixes bugs, including a minor fix that stops header and token values leaking into WSGI error output.
Performance patch: ~10% faster coverage phase on deeply nested bodies and ~5% faster stateful phase. Fixes several `st fuzz`, stateful and coverage-phase bugs.
Performance patch: stateful testing up to ~20% faster on link-heavy APIs. Fixes a `RecursionError` with self-referencing `additionalProperties`.
Stateful tests fill captured IDs into nested and `$ref` request bodies and infer links from response URLs. Adds stable failure codes, `st explain` and `--report pytest`.
